# Ayuzee

> Ayuzee is an AYUSH super-app for authentic Ayurveda and holistic wellness — book verified doctors, buy authentic medicines, and access homeopathy, Siddha, Unani, Yoga and Naturopathy services online.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of Ayuzee — doctors, medicines, therapies, and wellness tools.
- [Doctors](/doctors): Search verified AYUSH doctors and book video or in-clinic consultations.
- [Shop](/shop): Authentic Ayurvedic and AYUSH medicines, with prescription upload and tracking.
- [Shop by Condition](/shop/conditions): Browse medicines organized by health condition.
- [Panchakarma Shop](/shop/panchakarma): Panchakarma-related products and kits.
- [AYUSH Surgicals](/shop/surgicals): Surgical and clinical supplies for AYUSH practice.
- [Treatment Kits](/shop/treatment-kits): Curated condition-specific treatment kits.
- [Offers](/offers): Current discounts and promotions.
- [Clinics](/clinics): Discover AYUSH clinics across India.
- [Therapies](/therapies): Catalog of Ayurvedic and holistic therapies.
- [Therapists](/therapists): Find certified therapists for in-person sessions.
- [Health Conditions](/health-conditions): Condition library with AYUSH approaches.
- [Homeopathy](/homeopathy): Homeopathy hub — repertory, materia medica, and cases.
- [Acupuncture](/treatments/acupuncture): Acupuncture references and protocol guides.
- [Diagnosis](/diagnosis): Self-assessments including Prakriti and symptom checker.
- [Prakriti Test](/diagnosis/prakriti): Discover your Ayurvedic body constitution.
- [Learning](/learning): Courses, webinars, library, and blogs for AYUSH education.
- [Blogs](/learning/blogs): Articles on Ayurveda, wellness, and AYUSH practice.
- [Feed](/feed): Community feed of posts from doctors and patients.
- [Jobs](/jobs): AYUSH career and job listings.
- [Atmri Help](/atmri-help): Free treatment initiative for underprivileged patients.
- [Partner](/partner): Partnership opportunities with Ayuzee.

## Optional

- [Bulk](/bulk): Bulk medicine purchase for clinics and institutions.
- [Referral](/referral): Refer Ayuzee and earn rewards.
